ld.description: Mild by Nature® Peppermint & Shea Foot Cream Argan and Marula Oils with Aloe Vera, and Vitamin E Premium Oils from Rosehip, Avocado, Coconut, Jojoba, and Olive pH Balanced and Cruelty-Free For Soft, Smooth, Healthier-Looking Skin Formulated Without Parabens, Phthalates or Dyes No Fragrance Added Made in the USA with Globally Sourced Materials Everyday life can take quite a toll on your feet, leaving them feeling tired and the skin dry and uncomfortable. Mild by Nature® Peppermint & Shea Foot Cream is the perfect way to pamper your feet after a long day. This concentrated, moisture-rich cream helps to soothe and heal rough, cracked feet and heels. Our Foot Cream features hydrating shea butter and is infused with peppermint, argan and marula oils that lend a soothing scent to help calm the senses and the skin. The formula is completed with a premium blend of select oils, including avocado and coconut oil, that are rich in essential fatty acids, helping to refresh, nourish and moisturize your skin for softer, healthier feet.
